question: With selector v2 now independently verified for full-spline coverage, can all five frozen Cano topology families complete deterministic static CPU LiDAR, objective branch-label and frozen range-baseline contracts without tuning or partial-result reuse?
reason_now: The previous v2b pilot stopped at P04 because selector v1 could not reach 50 anchors. Selector v2 has now passed a separate five-map zero-ray audit with exact count, at least 5 m spacing, arc-length quotas and at most 7.5 m full-spline coverage. A clean corrective LiDAR pilot is required before any formal dataset or training design is activated.

prior_failure_boundary.reuse_policy: Read only for historical comparison. Do not copy, concatenate, count or use any old shard as a v3 observation; v3 must reconstruct and evaluate all five parents in one immutable run.

single_scientific_change.old_selector: Event-first farthest-point/earliest-fill selectors without a complete-spline coverage guarantee.
single_scientific_change.new_selector: Independently audited selector v2: structural events plus deterministic arc-length fill quotas, 0.5 m candidate lattice, exact 50 anchors, global Euclidean spacing >=5 m and full-spline same-tunnel/shared-event coverage radius <=7.5 m.

frozen_unchanged_scope.sensor: Open3D 0.19.0 CPU first-return, 16x720, 0.3--50 m, no noise
frozen_unchanged_scope.teacher: Frozen 5 m spline outgoing-heading oracle, 8 degree deduplication, sigma-3-degree 720-bin target
frozen_unchanged_scope.baseline: Frozen RangeExitBaseline; no threshold or parameter tuning

method.generation: Construct each declared topology once from its frozen topology seed and a graph-only replay for determinism; generate one native Cano perception mesh from its frozen geometry seed. No alternate seed, replacement, mesh repair or keep-best selection.
method.sampling: Run selector v2 independently on each complete graph/spline bundle, require exactly 50 scan-independent anchors, verify event coverage, exact arc-length fill quota, >=5 m global spacing and <=7.5 m full-spline same-tunnel coverage.
method.observation: At every anchor cast tangent-relative yaw offsets -30/0/+30 degrees using two fresh Open3D scenes. Each observation contains 16x720 range_m and valid_mask at 0.3--50 m, with no synthetic noise.
method.label: Generate objective outgoing headings from 5 m spline continuation and a 720-bin target. Graph and spline arrays may create labels and metrics but must never enter student arrays.
method.baseline: Replay the previously frozen RangeExitBaseline without threshold, sector, prominence or merge-angle tuning; report per-parent and aggregate precision, recall, F1 and angular error.
method.visual_evidence: Save five complete world/anchor maps, thirty deterministic contact pages covering all 750 observations exactly once, and aggregate sensor/label/baseline/coverage figures.

acceptance_criteria: Pinned source, E1 environment, proposal/card/tool hashes and the passed selector-v2 audit identity match before RUNNING.
Exactly five primary topology constructions, five graph-only replays and five native perception meshes are produced with frozen seeds and no retry or replacement.
All five topology family contracts, replay identities and topology/geometry seed-separation controls pass.
Exactly 250 anchors pass selector-v2 exact-count, event, arc-length-quota, >=5 m spacing and <=7.5 m full-spline coverage contracts.
Exactly 750 observations pass 16x720 shape/dtype/range/valid contracts and two-fresh-scene determinism.
Every anchor has horizontal clearance >=0.8 m and every objective 5 m branch has line of sight to target minus 0.25 m.
Exactly five diagnostic shards contain only student_range_m, student_valid_mask and teacher_exit_label_720; no graph/spline leakage.
Frozen-baseline metrics are reported per parent and in aggregate without becoming an adaptive PASS threshold.
Five complete maps and thirty contact pages represent all 750 views once with provenance and no best-case selection.
Formal dataset, labels-for-training, training, model, AI, Isaac, Gazebo, trajectory, online-topology and M-TARE counts remain zero.
Required logs, metrics, immutable RUN_STATE and SHA-256 manifest exist within 2 GB and 2 hours.
stop_rule: Stop and seal on the first approval, prerequisite, source, environment, topology, mesh, selector, sensor, determinism, clearance, branch-LOS, leakage, evidence, timeout or disk failure. Do not retry, lower thresholds, change seeds, select replacement parents or continue after a partial result.

estimated_cost.compute: One frozen-E1 CPU process; five primary plus five graph-only replay constructions, five native perception meshes, 750 static observations and 17.28 million rays across two scene passes; no GPU, API, simulator or training.

approval.confirmation_reference: 用户在收到五拓扑 LiDAR v3 的 5 mesh、250 anchors、750 views、17.28M rays、零训练和零 M-TARE 修改范围后回复：继续
